full_prompt_en: A square mixed pencil-and-paint illustration shows a dark-haired woman seated in profile before a large muted gold circular disk. She sits low with one knee bent high and her head lifted toward the upper left, as though studying something beyond the frame. A short black bob frames the face; a dark patterned garment covers her torso and legs. The gold disk occupies most of the upper center, like a weathered halo, but it is not luminous enough to erase the paper texture beneath. Around the figure lie pale dry grasses, faint architectural marks, and broad tan-gray ground. A few sketched shapes remain only partially resolved at the right, giving the work an unfinished quality. Her face and exposed arm are modeled with restrained gray-green and warm flesh tones, while the hair and folds carry deeper charcoal. Fine pencil outlines are visible through the paint, especially at the limbs, grass stems, and outer edge of the circle. Light is soft and indirect, lifting cheek and shoulder but leaving the clothing subdued. The composition is quiet and balanced, with the bent body echoing the disk's curvature. It feels contemplative, slightly mythic, and handmade, bringing a realistic human form into a sparse symbolic space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形铅笔与绘画混合插画描绘一位深发女子坐在大型低调金色圆盘前的侧面。她坐得很低，一膝高高弯起，头向左上仰，仿佛凝视画外。短黑波波头围住面孔；深色花纹衣物罩住躯干与腿。金盘占据上部中央大块区域，像风化光环，但并不亮到抹去下方纸纹。人物周围有淡干草、隐约建筑痕和宽阔棕灰地面。右侧几个草绘形体仍只部分完成，使作品带未完成感。她的脸和裸露手臂以克制灰绿与暖肤色塑形，头发和褶皱更深炭色。细铅笔轮廓透出色层，尤其在肢体、草茎和圆盘外缘。光柔和间接，提亮面颊与肩，衣物则低调。构图安静平衡，弯曲身体回应圆盘弧线。作品沉思、略有神话感且手工明显，把写实人体置入简省象征空间。
style_prompt_en: Mixed pencil-and-paint illustration lets fine graphite contours remain visible beneath thin muted color. Charcoal, olive-gray, weathered gold, and warm paper tones create a quiet restricted palette. One large circular field balances a compact bent focal form and spare linear grasses. Some edges are carefully modeled; others fade into sketch marks and unfinished ground. Soft indirect light lifts selected planes without sharp shadows. Paper grain and dry brush remain evident. The result is contemplative, slightly mythic, and delicately unresolved.
style_prompt_zh: 铅笔与颜料混合插画让细石墨轮廓透过低调薄色层。炭色、橄榄灰、风化金与暖纸色组成安静受限的配色。一个大圆色域平衡紧凑弯曲焦点与稀疏线状草形。有些边缘谨慎塑形，另一些淡入草线和未完成底面。柔和间接光提亮选定平面，不产生硬影。纸颗粒与干笔保持可见。结果沉思、微有神话感，也精致而有意未定。
theme_en: A seated dark-haired woman before a golden circular disk
theme_zh: 金色圆盘前坐着的深发女子
name: Jeffrey Catherine Jones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
